summary: Duynie is a Dutch company that turns co-products from the food and agri-industry into food, feed, petfood, technical and renewable products. For potatoes, it recovers starch from the process water of French fry and potato chip factories and refines it into food-grade and industrial starch. It is based in Katwijk (NB) and has operated since 1968.
products: Native and modified potato starch recovered from processors' process water
Food-grade upcycled potato starch (binder and thickener)
Modified potato starch for water-based drilling fluids
Potato starch for paper and packaging (wet end, size press, coating, corrugation)
Modified potato starch adhesives (wallpaper, paper sack and paper bag glue)
Modified potato starch for textile finishing and sizing
Starch Recovery Service for potato processors
markets: Drilling: oil and gas, mining, water and geothermal
facts: Drillamyl WP rated for temperatures up to 125°C; Stabodrill HT up to 150°C
